# QuickApp.ai

> AI-first commerce platform for Field Sales, Distributor Management, Retailer Portal, Van Sales, Store Operations, e-Commerce, Marketing, and Customer Service. One platform, unlimited users, success-based pricing.

QuickApp.ai is an enterprise SaaS platform built for FMCG, beverages, pharma, and consumer durables companies in India and beyond. It guides field teams, distributors, and retailers with intelligent recommendations instead of just collecting data, and runs securely on AWS with offline-first mobile apps.

## Solutions

- [Retailer Sales](/solutions/field-sales): AI-guided field sales execution for FMCG and consumer brands.
- [Distributor Management](/solutions/distributor-portal): Primary orders, inventory, claims, and ledgers for distributors.
- [Retailer Portal](/solutions/retailer-portal): Self-service ordering and engagement for retailers.
- [Van Sales](/solutions/van-sales): Mobile van inventory and on-the-spot invoicing.
- [Professional Services](/solutions/professional-services): Implementation, migration, and success services.
